_unavailable._note: Investigated 2026-09-16 against live apple.com. Deliberately left without a price. Do not fill these in without resolving the reason.
_unavailable.macbook_pro_scr14_0_chipm5_ram16_ssd512: Apple does not sell a 512GB SSD on the M5 14-inch MacBook Pro; storage starts at 1TB. Verified on https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro/14-inch (no occurrence of 512GB). The shop lists such a machine (parts MDE04, MDE44) but Apple publishes no US price for that configuration.
_unavailable.macbook_pro_scr14_0_chipm5_ram32_ssd512: Same: no 512GB option exists in the M5 generation.
_unavailable._m5_pro_core_tiers: The six macbook_pro_scr14_0_chipm5_pro_* keys are AMBIGUOUS and must stay empty until config_key distinguishes CPU/GPU cores. Apple sells the 14-inch M5 Pro in two tiers at different prices - 15-core CPU/16-core GPU 24GB/1TB is $2499 (sku MGDR4LL/A) while 18-core CPU/20-core GPU of the same memory and storage is $2699, both verified on apple.com on 2026-09-16. Every one of those six keys currently contains listings of BOTH tiers, so any single price would be wrong for some of the products it is applied to.
